DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Can I help you with anything?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 受け取った現金を家で使う封筒へ分けたいです。ただ、先に封筒へ入れると受取額が分からなくなるので、ここで確かめる場所を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 現金を用途封筒へ分割前に受取額を数える場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to divide the cash I received into envelopes for use at home. But if I put it into the envelopes first, I'll lose track of the amount I received, so please tell me where I can check it here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask where you can count the amount received before dividing the cash into envelopes for different purposes. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらの台でご確認いただけます。まだ現金は一つにまとまっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: You can check it at this counter. Is the cash still all together?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、まだ分けていません。受取った金額を数えて控えと合わせてから、家賃用と買物用へ分けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未分割で控えとの一致確認後家賃買物に分けたいと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, I haven't divided it yet. I'll count the amount I received and compare it with my receipt before dividing it into rent money and shopping money.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you haven't divided it and want to check it against the receipt before separating rent and shopping money. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 周りから見えすぎないように、ご自身で管理して確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please keep control of it yourself while checking, so it isn't too visible to others.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 台の上へ広く並べず、手元で数えます。数えている途中で電話が来たら、一度まとめてから出ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 広げず手元計数し電話時は先にまとめると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll count it close to me without spreading it widely over the counter. If my phone rings while I'm counting, I'll gather the money together before answering.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Reply that you'll count without spreading the cash out and gather it together before answering the phone. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 確認が終わったら、お金を残さずしまってください。金額に不明な点があれば窓口へお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: When you've finished checking, put all the money away without leaving any behind. If anything about the amount is unclear, please tell the service counter.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 合いました。家賃の封筒にいくら入れるかは、帰って家計メモを見てから決めます。ここでは受取額の確認だけにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 額一致後用途分配は帰宅時家計メモ確認後に決めると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: It matches. I'll decide how much to put in the rent envelope after I get home and check my household budget notes. Here I'll just check the amount I received.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that the amount matches and you'll decide the allocation after returning home and checking your household budget notes. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: では、まとめてお持ち帰りになりますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: So you'll take it home all together, then?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、今は一つの封筒へ入れます。控えは別にしまい、帰宅後に予定を見ながら分けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 今は一封へ現金を入れ控え別保管し帰宅後分けると確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, for now I'll put it into one envelope. I'll store the receipt separately and divide the cash at home while checking my plans.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm that you'll put the cash in one envelope for now, keep the receipt separately, and divide the money at home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 受取額の確認ができましたね。現金と控えのお忘れ物にお気を付けください。ご利用ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: You've checked the amount you received. Please be careful not to leave your cash or receipt behind. Thank you for using our services.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何をお探しでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What are you looking for?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 料理に香りを付ける葉と、皿に飾る葉を探しています。同じように緑なので、一つで両方使えるかと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 香り付け葉と皿飾り葉を同一で使えると思い用途相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm looking for leaves to add flavor to a dish and leaves to decorate the plate. They're both green, so I thought I might use one kind for both purposes.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about the uses of flavoring leaves and decorative leaves, explaining that you thought one kind could serve both purposes. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 作る料理と、葉を使う場面を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please tell me what dish you're making and how you'll use the leaves.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ご飯に刻んで混ぜる分と、盛付けの下へ敷く分です。こちらの袋は観賞用と書いてあり、食べる材料か分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 刻んで混ぜる分と敷く分で手元袋は観賞用表示と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Some will be chopped and mixed into rice, and some will be laid underneath the food. This bag says “for ornamental use,” so I don't know whether it's an edible ingredient.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that some leaves will be chopped and mixed in and others used underneath, and that the bag you have says ornamental use. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 観賞用の表示の物を、食材と同じ扱いにはしないでください。食材売場の商品から用途を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please don't treat something labeled for ornamental use in the same way as food. Let's check the purpose of products in the food section.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ご飯に混ぜる分は食材の表示を見て選びます。飾りも料理と触れるので、見た目だけで観賞用を買うのはやめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 混ぜる食材表示を確認し皿に触れる飾りも見た目のみで選ばないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll check the food labeling when choosing the leaves to mix into the rice. Since the decoration also touches the food, I won't buy ornamental leaves based only on appearance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Reply that you'll check the food label for the leaves you mix in and won't choose decorative leaves touching the food by appearance alone. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらの料理用の商品をご覧いただけます。使う量は決まっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can look at these products intended for cooking. Have you decided how much you'll use?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 二人分なので、今日は小さい袋を一つにします。刻む分と敷く分を分けて考え、同じ葉でも全部刻まないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 二人分小袋を選び刻む分と敷く分を分けると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: It's for two people, so I'll take one small bag today. I'll plan separately for the leaves to chop and those to lay underneath, so I don't chop all of them even if they're the same kind.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you'll choose a small bag for two people and separate the leaves to chop from those to lay underneath. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 袋の表示と扱い方をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check the bag's label and handling instructions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 食材の商品を選び、用途と表示を確かめます。帰宅後は刻む分だけ取り分け、飾りの分は別に残します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 料理用表示扱いを確認し帰宅後用途ごとに取り分けると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll choose a food product and check its intended uses and label. At home, I'll set aside only the leaves to chop and keep the decorative portion separate.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you'll check the cooking label and handling instructions, then separate the leaves by use at home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 料理用の売場でお選びください。表示で迷う所があればお声がけください。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please choose from the cooking section. Let us know if you're unsure about any labeling. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。公園で何かお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Can I help you with anything in the park?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 子どもへ絵本を読みたいです。声を大きくして読まず、近くで聞ける席を探しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 子への絵本を大声でなく隣で聞ける席で読みたいと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to read a picture book to my child. I'm looking for seats where they can hear me nearby without my reading loudly.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for seats where your child can listen beside you while you read a picture book without raising your voice. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お二人ですか。通路のベンチより、こちらの休憩場所はいかがですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Are there two of you? How about this rest area rather than a bench along the walkway?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 二人です。ここなら並んで座れます。人が通る度に本を閉じなくてよいよう、入口の正面は避けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 親子二人で並び入口正面の通行を避けたいと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: There are two of us. We can sit side by side here. I'd like to avoid sitting directly in front of the entrance so we don't have to close the book whenever someone passes.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you and your child need to sit together and want to avoid people passing directly in front of the entrance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらの空いている席を使えます。ほかの方の休憩もあるので、音量はご配慮ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can use these vacant seats. Other people also rest here, so please be considerate about your volume.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 子どもが隣で聞ける声にします。録音した音を流すのでなく、ゆっくり読んで、途中で絵を見る時間を取ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 隣へ届く声で録音再生せずゆっくり読み絵を見る間を取ると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll use a voice my child can hear beside me. Rather than playing a recording, I'll read slowly and leave time to look at the pictures along the way.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Reply that you'll read slowly in a voice audible beside you without playing recordings, allowing time to look at the pictures. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 荷物もご自身の席の範囲へまとめてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please also keep your belongings within the area of your own seats.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: かばんは足元へ置きます。次に読む本を別の席へ並べて確保せず、今読む一冊だけ出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: かばんを足元にし次本を別席へ置かず一冊だけ出すと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll put my bag at my feet. I won't spread the next books across other seats to reserve them; I'll only take out the one we're reading now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you'll keep the bag at your feet and take out just one book, without placing later books on other seats. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 長く読む場合は、お子様の様子も見ながら休憩してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: If you read for a long time, please take breaks while watching how your child is doing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 一冊読んだら子どもに続きを聞きたいか尋ねます。終える時は本とかばんをまとめ、席を空けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 一冊後子へ継続希望を聞き終了時本荷物をまとめ席を空けると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: After one book, I'll ask my child whether they want to hear more. When we finish, I'll gather the book and bag and leave the seats free.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you'll ask your child after one book whether they want to continue, then gather your things and free the seats when finished. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 周りの休憩に気を付けながらお楽しみください。お声がけありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please enjoy yourselves while being considerate of others resting nearby. Thank you for asking.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Can I help you with anything?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: このかばんの車輪が大きい音を出します。階段では持つつもりですが、途中で持ち替える場所を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 車輪音の大きいかばんを階段で持つため持替位置を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: The wheels on this bag make a loud noise. I plan to carry it on the stairs, but I'd like to check where I can stop to change how I'm carrying it along the way.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask where you can switch to carrying a noisy wheeled bag by hand for the stairs. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 車輪が外れたり、引けなくなったりしていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Have any wheels come off, or has it become impossible to pull?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 引けますが、一つが滑らかに回りません。無理に速く引くと音が大きくなるので、ゆっくり移動しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 引けるが一輪回転不良で急ぐと音が増すためゆっくり移動と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I can pull it, but one wheel doesn't turn smoothly. Pulling it fast by force makes the noise louder, so I'm moving slowly.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you can pull it but one wheel turns poorly, so you're moving slowly because going faster makes it noisier. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 通路で急に止まらず、こちらの脇で持ち替えられます。重さは持てる範囲ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Instead of stopping suddenly in the passage, you can switch to carrying it at this side area. Is it a weight you can lift?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 階段一つなら持てます。ただ、全区間を持つと疲れるので、階段の前後で止まれる所を知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 階段一つは持てるが全区間は疲れ前後で準備位置を知りたいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I can carry it up one flight of stairs. But carrying it the whole way would tire me out, so I'd like to know where I can stop before and after the stairs.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you can carry it over one staircase but the whole route would be tiring, so you want preparation spots before and after the stairs. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 階段前の表示脇で通行を空けて準備してください。移動に支援が必要な場合は係へご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please prepare beside the sign before the stairs, keeping the passage clear. If you need assistance moving, please consult a staff member.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: そこで取っ手をしまい、持ち手で上げます。片手に飲物もあるので、先にふたをしてかばんへ入れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 階段前で取手をしまい飲物を先に収納して持ち手で運ぶと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll retract the pull handle there and lift it by its carrying handle. I also have a drink in one hand, so I'll close the lid and put it in the bag first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Reply that you'll retract the pull handle before the stairs, put the drink away first, and carry the bag by its handle. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 階段では周囲の方に気を付けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please watch out for people around you on the stairs.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 飲物をしまって両手を使えるようにし、階段前で持ち替えます。重くて難しければ途中で無理をせず係へ相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 両手が使える準備後持替え重ければ係へ支援相談すると確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll put the drink away so I can use both hands and change my grip before the stairs. If it's too heavy to manage, I won't force myself partway through; I'll ask staff for help.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm that you'll prepare to use both hands, switch how you carry it, and ask staff for assistance if it's too heavy. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 準備してからお進みください。移動にお困りの際はお声がけください。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please get ready before proceeding. Let us know if you have difficulty moving. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。どのような案内をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What kind of information are you looking for?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 市のサイトをここで開こうとしましたが、通信が不安定です。家で読むため、ページ名と担当の名前を紙に控えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 通信不安定で市サイトページと担当名を紙へ控え自宅で読みたいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I tried to open the city's website here, but the connection is unstable. I'd like to write the page title and the responsible department's name on paper so I can read it at home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say the connection is unstable and you want to note the city website's page and responsible office on paper to read at home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 何について調べたいのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: What would you like to look up?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 家庭向けの日本語教室です。申込を今ここで送るのではなく、時間帯と対象を家族と見てから決めたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 家庭向け日本語教室を即申込せず時間対象を家族と確認後決めたいと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Japanese classes for families. I don't want to submit an application here now; I'd like to decide after checking the times and eligible participants with my family.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you want to decide about family Japanese classes after checking the schedule and eligibility with your family, rather than apply immediately. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 教室の案内ページと担当の名称をご案内できます。ページ名だけでなく発行元も控えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: We can tell you the class information page and the name of the department responsible. Please note the publisher as well as the page title.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 市のサイトの案内だと分かるように書きます。検索で似た教室が出ても、同じ募集と思って申し込まないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 市の発行元を控え検索類似教室と同じ募集とみなさないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll write it so I know it's information from the city's website. Even if a search finds similar classes, I won't assume it's the same recruitment and apply for it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Reply that you'll note the city as publisher and won't regard similar classes found in a search as the same recruitment. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 募集期間も閲覧時にご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please also check the application period when you view it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい、家で開いた時に今年の募集か確かめます。家族の都合を聞き、期間内に相談できるか考えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 閲覧時今年の期間を確かめ家族都合と締切内相談を考える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, I'll check at home whether it's this year's recruitment. I'll ask about my family's availability and consider whether we can consult within the application period.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you'll check this year's application period when viewing, ask about family availability, and consider consulting before the deadline. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ページの資料が読めない場合は、その担当へお問い合わせいただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: If you can't read the documents on the page, you can contact that department.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ページ名、発行元、担当名を控えます。家で内容を読み、表示できない所があれば担当へ用件を伝えて聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: ページ発行元担当を控え読めぬ資料は担当へ用件質問すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll note the page title, publisher, and department name. I'll read the content at home, and if anything won't display, I'll explain what I need to the department and ask.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you'll note the page, publisher, and department, and ask the department about any documents you can't read, explaining your purpose. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご自宅で確認するための案内ですね。こちらの名称をお控えください。お問い合わせありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: So this is information for you to check at home. Please note these names. Thank you for your inquiry.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。受付で何かお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Can I help you with anything at reception?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 今日は声が出しづらいので、受付の用件をメモで伝えてもよいですか。言葉は聞き取れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 声が出しづらいが聞取れるので受付メモ利用を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: It's hard for me to speak today. May I communicate my reason for coming to reception in a note? I can understand what you say.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask to use a note at reception because speaking is difficult but you can understand spoken words. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: メモでお知らせいただけます。受診のご予約はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: You can let us know with a note. Do you have a medical appointment?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 予約があります。この紙に名前と時刻を書きました。話せないから質問が分からない、というわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 予約氏名時刻を紙で示し発話困難と理解不能を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have an appointment. I've written my name and the time on this paper. Difficulty speaking doesn't mean I don't understand the questions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show your appointment name and time on paper and distinguish difficulty speaking from difficulty understanding. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご予約を確認します。質問には指差しやメモで返答できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll check your appointment. Can you answer questions by pointing or writing notes?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、短い返事は書けます。選択肢を見せていただければ指で示しますが、意味が分からない時は紙に質問を書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 短文や指差しで返答し不明選択肢は質問を紙に書くと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, I can write short answers. If you show me options, I'll point to one, but if I don't understand their meaning, I'll write a question on paper.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you can answer with short notes or pointing and will write a question if an option is unclear. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご希望を担当へ伝えます。受付後も、そのメモをお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll tell the person in charge about your preference. Please keep that note with you after reception as well.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 診察で説明したいことは別の紙に書いてあります。受付の名前と時刻の紙だけで、症状の説明が全部済んだとは考えていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 症状別紙があり受付氏名時刻だけで診察説明完了とは考えないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: What I want to explain in the consultation is written on another sheet. I don't think that the paper with only my name and appointment time means I've finished explaining all my symptoms.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Reply that symptoms are on a separate sheet and giving reception just your name and time doesn't complete the medical explanation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 診察の担当へ別の紙もご提示ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please also show that other sheet to the person handling your consultation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 受付はこの名前と時刻で確認し、診察ではもう一枚を見せます。質問を聞き、指差しや追加のメモで自分から返事をします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 受付確認後診察で別紙と指差し追加メモで本人返答すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll have reception check this name and time, and show the other sheet in the consultation. I'll listen to questions and answer for myself by pointing or adding notes.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you'll confirm reception details, then answer for yourself during the consultation using the separate sheet, pointing, and additional notes. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 声を使わない返答方法の希望で承りました。担当へご案内します。お大事になさってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: We've noted your request for ways to answer without using your voice. We'll guide you to the person in charge. Please take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。どのようなご用件でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 昨日かばんの紛失を相談しましたが、家の収納の奥で見付かりました。届出したままにせず、そのことをお伝えしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 昨日紛失相談したかばんが家で発見され記録更新を知らせたいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yesterday I asked about a missing bag, but I found it deep inside a storage space at home. Rather than leave the report as it is, I'd like to tell you about that.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that the bag reported missing yesterday was found at home and you want the record updated. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 昨日のご相談の控えはお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you have the copy of yesterday's consultation record?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、これです。似た物を見付けたのではなく、自分の名前札と中の手帳で本人のかばんだと確認しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 控えと名前札手帳で本人かばんと照合済みと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, here it is. I didn't just find something similar; I confirmed it was my own bag from my name tag and the planner inside.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you have the record and confirmed the bag was yours using the name tag and planner. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 見付かった時刻と場所を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please tell me when and where you found it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今朝八時ごろ、自分の家の収納です。誰かが返しに来たのではありません。家族が置き直したかどうかはまだ聞いていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 朝八時自宅収納で発見し返却者はなく家族移動の有無は未確認と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: At about eight this morning, in storage at my own home. No one came to return it. I haven't yet asked whether someone in my family moved it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say it was found in home storage at eight this morning, no one returned it, and you haven't checked whether family moved it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご自身で確認した発見として記録します。中身で足りない物はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll record it as a discovery you verified yourself. Is anything missing from inside?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: いつも入れる手帳と水筒はあります。ほかの物まで全てそろったと言う前に家で確認し、今はその二つだけ確認済みです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 手帳水筒は確認済みだが全中身の充足は未確認と答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: My usual planner and water bottle are there. I'll check at home before saying every other item is present too; for now, I've confirmed only those two.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Reply that you've confirmed the planner and bottle, but haven't checked that all the contents are present. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認したことを担当へお知らせください。相談内容の扱いも担当がご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please tell the person in charge what you've checked. They will also explain how your consultation will be handled.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 昨日の控えで、自宅で本人の物を見付けたと伝えます。確認済みの中身と未確認を分け、必要な案内を聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 控えに基づく発見連絡と中身確認範囲を分け相談扱いを聞くと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll use yesterday's record to report finding my own bag at home. I'll distinguish the contents I've checked from what I haven't and listen to the necessary guidance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you'll report the discovery using the record, distinguish the scope of the contents checked, and ask how the consultation is handled. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 発見のご連絡を受けました。担当へ引き継ぎます。お知らせありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: We've received your report that it was found. I'll pass it to the person in charge. Thank you for letting us know.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。荷物について何かお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Can I help you with your package?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家族へ上着を送ります。閉じる前にポケットを確認したら、自分の鍵が入っていました。まだほかにも残っていないか確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 送る上着の鍵に気付き他私物もないか封前確認したいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm sending a jacket to my family. When I checked the pockets before sealing it, I found my own keys inside. I'd like to check whether anything else is still there.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you noticed keys in the jacket to be sent and want to check for other personal items before sealing it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 箱はまだ開いている状態ですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、開いています。外の二つのポケットを見て、鍵と小さい紙を出しました。内ポケットはまだです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 箱未封で外二ポケットから鍵紙を出し内は未確認と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, it's open. I checked the two outer pockets and removed the keys and a small piece of paper. I haven't checked the inner pocket yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the box is unsealed, you removed keys and paper from two outer pockets, and the inner pocket is unchecked. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご自身の物を確認してから封をしてください。作業台はこちらを使えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please check your own belongings before sealing it. You can use this work surface.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 内ポケットも見ます。紙は送るメモだと思ってそのまま入れず、中に個人の控えがないか自分で確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 内も確認し紙を送るメモとみなさず個人控え有無を調べると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll check the inner pocket too. I won't assume the paper is a note to send and leave it in; I'll check myself whether there are any personal records in there.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Reply that you'll check inside too and won't assume the paper is a note to send, but will check for personal records. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 取り出した鍵などは、お手元で管理してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please keep control of the keys and other things you remove.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 鍵は自分のかばんへしまいます。箱の端に置いたまま閉じるとまた入ってしまうので、取り出した物は全部分けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 鍵等を自分かばんへ分け箱端へ置いたまま再混入させないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll put the keys in my own bag. If I leave them on the edge of the box and close it, they might go in again, so I'll separate everything I take out.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you'll put keys and other removed items in your own bag, keeping them apart rather than leaving them at the box edge to get mixed back in. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認後は、衣類と同封する物だけで包装を整えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: After checking, prepare the packaging with only the clothing and anything intended to go with it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 全ポケットを確認し、鍵と私的な紙は手元へ分けます。上着と家族へのメモだけにして、箱を閉じてから発送を相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 全ポケット確認後上着と家族メモだけにして封包装後発送相談すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll check all the pockets and keep the keys and personal papers with me separately. I'll leave only the jacket and the note for my family, then close the box before asking about shipping.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you'll check every pocket, leave only the jacket and family note, seal the packaging, then consult about shipping. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 内容物を確認してからお声がけください。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please let us know after checking the contents. Thank you for consulting us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。今日はどのようなご相談でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What would you like to ask about today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 子どもの生まれた年の百円硬貨を記念に残したいです。百円を用意すれば、その年が書かれた一枚へ交換してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 子どもの出生年表示のある百円硬貨への交換を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to keep a hundred-yen coin from the year my child was born as a keepsake. If I provide a hundred yen, can I exchange it for a coin bearing that year?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about exchanging for a hundred-yen coin bearing your child's birth year. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 百円という金種ではなく、硬貨にある年の表示を指定したいのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: So you want to specify the year on the coin, rather than just the denomination of one hundred yen?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。生まれたのは二〇一五年です。新しくてきれいな硬貨なら何年でもよいという意味ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 二〇一五年という指定を示し硬貨の新しさや金種だけの希望ではないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. My child was born in 2015. I don't mean that any year is fine as long as the coin is new and shiny.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Specify 2015 and explain that your request isn't merely about the coin being new or the denomination. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この窓口では、年の表示を選んで硬貨をお渡しする扱いはありません。通常の両替とはご希望が異なります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: At this counter we don't provide coins selected by the year marked on them. Your request is different from an ordinary money exchange.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。百円玉を何枚も受け取れば、その中に必ず目的の年があると考えていたので、両替の申込みはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 年指定不可の説明を受け多数の硬貨を取れば必ず入るという期待を取り下げ両替を申し込まない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I understand. I'd been thinking that if I received many hundred-yen coins, the year I wanted would definitely be among them, so I won't apply for an exchange.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: After hearing that a year can't be specified, withdraw the expectation that many coins would guarantee the desired year and don't request an exchange. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 記念に残す目的でしたら、硬貨だけでなく、お写真などを使う方法もあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: If your purpose is a keepsake, you could use something like photographs rather than only a coin.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 家に生まれた時の写真があります。硬貨が見付かるまで待たず、写真に日付と家族の短い言葉を添えて記念の台紙を作ろうと思います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 硬貨探しを待たず写真と日付と家族の言葉を使う記念の作り方を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have a photograph from when my child was born at home. Rather than wait until I find the coin, I think I'll make a commemorative display with the photo, date, and a few words from the family.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Choose a keepsake using a photo, date, and family message without waiting to find the coin. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そのご準備で、ほかに銀行でお手続きになることはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Is there anything else you need to arrange at the bank for those preparations?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日はありません。持って来た百円は持ち帰ります。硬貨の年を指定する相談と、普通の両替を分けて考えられました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 他の銀行手続きもなく持参現金を持ち帰ると伝えて年指定相談を終える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Not today. I'll take home the hundred yen I brought. I've been able to distinguish a request for a specific coin year from an ordinary exchange.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you have no other bank business and will take your cash home, ending the inquiry about a specific year. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。本日は両替のお申込みはありませんね。お気を付けてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. So there is no exchange application today. Please have a safe trip home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。食材についてお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Can I help you with ingredients?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 今夜は豆腐を二品に使います。片方は崩して混ぜ、もう片方は四角いまま出したいので、同じ一パックで足りるか考えています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 豆腐二品で崩す分と四角を残す分に同一パックで足りるか相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm using tofu in two dishes tonight. For one I'll crumble and mix it, and for the other I want to serve it in squares, so I'm considering whether one pack will be enough for both.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether one pack of tofu will be enough for two dishes, with one part crumbled and another kept square. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: それぞれ何人分でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: How many people is each dish for?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 二人分ずつです。大きい一パックを全部崩してから、形を残す分がないと気付くのは避けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 各二人分で全て崩して形残し分がなくなるのを避けたいと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Each is for two people. I want to avoid crumbling an entire large pack and only then realizing there's none left to keep its shape.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that each is for two people and you want to avoid crumbling everything and leaving no intact portion. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 容量と種類を表示で確認できます。料理ごとに分けて選ぶこともできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can check the quantity and type on the label. You can also choose separate packs for each dish.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 小さいパックを二つにします。混ぜる方と、そのまま出す方を買物メモへ分けて書き、帰ってから一度に開けないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 小パック二つを用途メモで分け一度に開けないと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll take two small packs. I'll write the mixing portion and the portion to serve as is separately on my shopping list so I don't open both at once when I get home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you'll choose two small packs, note their separate purposes, and not open them at the same time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 硬さなどの好みも、商品の表示をご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please also check the product labels for your preferred firmness and other qualities.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: そのまま出す方は、いつも食べている種類にします。崩す方は別の商品を試しますが、食べたことがあると家族へ言うつもりはありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: そのままは既知種類崩す分は新商品で既経験とは家族へ言わないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: For the one to serve as is, I'll choose the kind we usually eat. I'll try a different product for crumbling, but I won't tell my family we've had it before.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Reply that you'll use a familiar type for serving intact and a new product for crumbling, without telling family you've tried it before. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 開封前に商品と用途をもう一度ご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check the product and its intended use once more before opening it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 二つの用途で小パックを選びます。帰宅後、形を残す方を先に取り分けてから、別の方を崩して調理します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二用途購入後形を残す分を先に取り分け別商品を崩すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll choose small packs for the two purposes. At home, I'll set aside the one to keep its shape first, then crumble the other product to cook it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you'll buy for two purposes, set aside the intact portion first at home, and crumble the separate product. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 容量と種類をお確かめください。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08211-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please check the quantities and types. Thank you for consulting us.
